pages.title: Omnipotence Casing
pages.text: Material that cannot be broken because breaking it is not among the things that can happen. Tools pass over it without effect. It is not hard; it is simply exempt, and touching it feels like pressing against the end of an argument.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Found forming the walls of the deepest structures. I tried every tool and every machine I have. Nothing. I logged it as a boundary condition rather than a material.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Eschaton Foundry, Pleroma Reconstitutor.
